Dear [Lady Leconfield](../persons.html#1664)
As [Christabel Coleridge](../persons.html#329) is here, I shall ask her to put in her autograph She is the remnant of my original [Goslings](../others.html#104) worked on as a [Spider](../others.html#116) and now edits the [Packet](../others.html#52), anxious to raise the tone, and bear it through the bad times for periodicals If you have read [Waynflete](../others.html#205), the [Main Chance](../others.html#206) and [The Tender Mercies](../others.html#207), you will think her autograph worth having.

She is the granddaughter of [S T Coleridge](../persons.html#1667)

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
